heroSubtitle: Quick answers to frequently asked questions about Lasuarindo Group.

items.question: What is Lasuarindo Group?
items.answer: Lasuarindo Group is an integrated business and investment company operating in property, investment, technology, commerce, creative & media, and tourism.

items.question: Where is the Lasuarindo Group office?
items.answer: Our office is located at Jl. Tamblong No.46, Kb. Pisang, Kec. Sumur Bandung, Kota Bandung, Jawa Barat 40112, Indonesia.

items.question: How do I contact Lasuarindo Group?
items.answer: You can email contact@lasuarindo.co.id or use the form on the Contact page.

items.question: Does Lasuarindo Group welcome partnerships?
items.answer: Yes. We are open to strategic collaborations with investors, entrepreneurs, and institutions. Please share your proposal through the Contact page.

items.question: Can the contact form be used for general inquiries?
items.answer: Yes. The contact form can be used for general questions, information requests, and collaboration proposals.
